description: Administrative boundary data (N03) of the National Land Numerical Information, as of 1 January 2026. Boundaries of all 1,905 municipalities in Japan (wards for designated cities), one multipolygon row per municipality.

table:columns.name: admin_code
table:columns.description: Original column: N03_007. Local government code (5-digit string, without the check digit) - 2-digit prefecture code followed by a 3-digit municipality code. Designated cities are split into wards, each with its own code. Areas of undetermined jurisdiction are "<prefecture code>000". Unique per row.

table:columns.name: pref_code
table:columns.description: Added column (not in the source). Prefecture code (2-digit string, 01 Hokkaido to 47 Okinawa). The first two digits of admin_code.

table:columns.name: pref_name
table:columns.description: Original column: N03_001. Prefecture name (in Japanese).

table:columns.name: subprefecture_name
table:columns.description: Original column: N03_002. Name of the Hokkaido subprefecture (in Japanese). Null outside Hokkaido.

table:columns.name: county_name
table:columns.description: Original column: N03_003. County name (in Japanese). Only for towns and villages that belong to a county; null for cities, wards and towns or villages outside a county.

table:columns.name: municipality_name
table:columns.description: Original column: N03_004. Municipality name (city, town, village, or special ward of Tokyo; in Japanese). On rows for wards of designated cities this is the city name (e.g. "札幌市") and the ward is in ward_name. "所属未定地" on rows for areas of undetermined jurisdiction.

table:columns.name: ward_name
table:columns.description: Original column: N03_005. Ward name of a designated city (in Japanese, e.g. "中央区"). Null outside designated cities. Tokyo's special wards are in municipality_name, not here.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Feature bounding box (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax). The GeoParquet 1.1 bbox covering column, used to skip row groups in spatial filters.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Boundary of the municipality (ward for designated cities) as a multipolygon in EPSG:4326. Islands that were separate rows in the source are combined into one multipolygon; the shapes are unchanged.

title: Administrative boundaries
